entities.name: Łukasz Kadziewicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Łukasz Kadziewicz is a Polish former professional volleyball player, a member of the Poland national team in 2001–2009. A participant of the Olympic Games, and a silver medalist at the 2006 World Championship. He worked as a volleyball commentator for Polsat Sport.
